title: broke after gently setting on granite counter
text: broke after gently setting on granite counter. The glass on these is razor thin, if you have granite counter tops it's only a matter of WHEN this will break being gently set down, not IF.

product_metadata.title: Borosilicate Glass Pitcher with Lid and Spout - 68 Ounces Cold and Hot Water Carafe with Unique Diamond Pattern, Beverage Pitcher for Homemade Iced Tea and Juice.
features: ✅ UNIQUE DIAMOND DESIGN - Are you tired to look for a stylish clear glass pitcher? Congratulations, you found it! Our decorative glass jug has a beautiful vintage look due to its unique design with diamond pattern. It's perfect for serving water for any occasion and will enhance every table and kitchen. This elegant design is handmade, beautiful looking and has a large handle for comfortable grip. With a capacity of 68 ounces (2 liter), it holds plenty of your favorite drinks.

✅ BOROSILICATE GLASS FOR HOT AND COLD - Premium borosilicate glass. This water jug can withstand temperatures from 0 °F to 300 °F. Safely pour boiling water into this vase pitcher and make your own delicious iced tea. Stove-top and microwave safe (without lid), stays clear and heat resistant. Surprise your guests with your homemade beverages, lemonade juices, fruit infused water, milk or even a margarita cocktail. You'll enjoy your lightweight and durable hand-blown glass pitcher!

✅ 2 WAY STAINLESS STEEL LID - You decide: wide open or filtered mouth. The filter will keep the ice cubes, fruit, or tea bags inside. Perfect as sangria jar. The removable lid is made from stainless steel and is BPA free. The silicon ring inside the cap will ensure the lid remains secure and will avoid any spilling. The spout is nicely designed to avoid any drip after serving. Get ready to serve your drinks in style with this modern glass pitcher. Please note that the lid is not airtight.

✅ SECURE GIFT PACKAGING - Are you looking for unique gifts for women or men? Perfect! Our designers have created a remarkably elegant and trendy gift box. On top of that, unlike other pitchers, we include polyfoam protection to secure the glass water decanter during transportation. You can rest assured, you make the right choice and we are confident this present will put a smile on anyone that gets this truly unique glass water pitcher!
✅ EASE OF USE - Our environmentally friendly iced tea pitcher is lead-free and BPA free. Dishwasher safe (without lid), but we recommend hand wash for both the lid and the pitcher. Easy to clean.
